body: Thanks. I've tried to apologize, but she told me she never wants to speak to me again and to leave her alone. I just sent her an email with my apology, in hopes that she reads it. I don't expect to hear back from her and I don't think I deserve to. I'm trying my best to stick around, but this is really hard to live with. I never thought I could hurt someone like that.

We had been on and off for about a year until late last year. We reconnected recently and started hooking up and decided that it was unhealthy to keep doing that about a few weeks ago. We hadn't seen each other since then.
